ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters; estimated macro-level ratio is approximately 80:20.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white pixel formations are distributed as discrete dots and ring-shaped annuli. Notable spatial clustering is observed along the trailing edges of both lobes and in high density within the lower-central region near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a defined vertex angle of approximately 65-70 degrees and significant bounding-box depth extending into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) detected along the entire trailing boundary of both lobes, with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 2 to 12 pixels from the mean edge curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing boundary follows a convex geometric sweep originating from the median notch and extending laterally to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel rings (annuli) across the visible surface, with major clusters located in the mid-central region and along the distal trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (length 10-30 pixels) visible primarily on the lower-left quadrant of the fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white circular scarring (consistent with barnacle colonization) across the entire visible ventral area; highly irregular and ragged trailing edge topography suggestive of historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'figure-eight' and interconnected ring-shaped white pixel formations concentrated near the central vertical axis.
